scope.audit_question: Whether the proposed Stage A-E object-topology design and both rounds of P-priority recommendations were actually implemented and passed their stated promotion gates.

status_definitions.implemented: The recommendation itself, rather than a weaker proxy, is implemented and its local contract is validated. This does not automatically mean benchmark promotion.
status_definitions.partial: Some code, assets, benchmark subset, or a weaker diagnostic exists, but the recommendation is not closed as specified.
status_definitions.not_implemented: The defining mechanism or required materialized asset is absent.
status_definitions.promotion_rule: A result is promotable only when the exact recommended mechanism is evaluated under its preregistered gates without protocol leakage or regression of required metrics. Code availability and a positive pooled mIoU delta are insufficient.

executive_conclusion.reason_observed_gains_are_small: The current experiments mostly add bounded boundary, neighborhood, or extent residuals to primitive identity scores. They do not yet build the query-independent multi-granularity SAM-derived 3D proposal hierarchy that the attachment identifies as the main missing object-membership representation.
most_important_missing_chain: query-independent automatic source-view SAM mask hierarchy
joint-visibility-aware positive, negative, and unknown co-membership
proposal-level text identity selection with adaptive extent projection
executive_conclusion.current_evidence_interpretation: The small positive LERF2D, corrected LERF3D, and ScanNet development deltas support the identity-versus-extent diagnosis, but they are mechanism probes rather than validation of the complete proposed method.

current_lerf3d_promotion.reason: Boundary-F and trimap IoU regress, Ramen and Waldo regress in mIoU, and proposal generation uses benchmark query strings rather than a query-independent hierarchy.

executive_conclusion.superseded_claim: The LERF3D 0.48451 to 0.49513 v1 row in region_instance_prior_method_improvements_20260817.json is superseded by the SAM3 probability-tensor contract audit and must not be cited as the current result.

latest_attachment_object_topology_stages.recommendation: Run frozen official SAM on legal source RGB to produce an automatic multi-granularity mask hierarchy, with masked/context crop descriptors, scale, boundary confidence, SAM quality, and pose.
gaps: No current LERF full4 query-independent automatic multi-scale mask hierarchy is materialized.
The reviewed Figurines query-free pilot is only eight source views with a single-scale 12x12 point grid: 67 proposals cover 7/21 field identity seeds in one view and 1/21 in two views.

A dense one-frame crop-pyramid sentinel now forms 13 proposals and five containment parent edges, and a sparse masked/context SigLIP2 teacher precursor exists; neither has yet been materialized across full legal source views or associated across views.

promotion.reason: Reusable builders exist, but the defining current full4 assets do not.

latest_attachment_object_topology_stages.recommendation: Lift mask probabilities with exact front-to-back marginal responsibility and construct co-membership with positive evidence, jointly-visible confident negative evidence, and unknown elsewhere.
gaps: Probability-correct exact-MPR lifting now exists for a reviewed query-free eight-view sparse pilot, but not for the requested full multiscale hierarchy.
Joint visibility, mutually exclusive confident negatives, and explicit unknown pair labels are not implemented as the recommended Stage-B authority.
The original v1 lifting applied sigmoid twice and is invalid for quantitative comparison.

promotion.reason: The corrected lifting primitive is valid, but the required source hierarchy and ternary co-membership contract are absent.

latest_attachment_object_topology_stages.recommendation: Train a 16-32D affinity decoder from the existing latent state or a sparse-edge pair MLP using source-only same-instance supervision.
gaps: A source-validation co-membership candidate passed its source gate, but the formal Figurines target readout was rejected: 0.33980 versus 0.47539 primitive O0 mIoU.
The rejected target construction produced singleton regions because accepted edges were unreachable.
The healthy query-free native-v3 topology artifact explicitly makes no benchmark-improvement claim and has not completed the recommended query/readout evaluation.

promotion.reason: Source-only feasibility is established, but the target topology/readout failed and the complete Stage-C head is not promoted.

latest_attachment_object_topology_stages.recommendation: Build a query-independent primitive, patch, object, and object-group 3D hierarchy with deterministic membership and pooled statistics.
gaps: The cited implementation is an identity-seeded bounded residual, not a persistent query-independent four-level hierarchy.
There is no materialized full4 membership, parent-child, geometry, and pooled-statistics authority derived from Stage A-C.

promotion.reason: The defining hierarchy is absent.

latest_attachment_object_topology_stages.recommendation: Score identity at proposal level, project proposal membership to Gaussians, preserve primitive fallback, and use adaptive reliability/query-conditioned fusion rather than fixed averaging.
gaps: The current implementation is a bounded query-conditioned extent residual, not proposal-level semantic selection over a query-independent hierarchy.
It lacks mask-aligned proposal descriptors, explicit primitive/patch/object/group candidates, and the proposed adaptive lambda contract.
Corrected same-pipeline full4 mIoU rises by 0.00793, but Boundary-F and trimap IoU regress and Ramen/Waldo regress in mIoU.

promotion.reason: It is a useful mechanism probe but fails both method-identity and all-metrics gates.

latest_attachment_object_topology_priori.recommendation: Without retraining the field, build a query-independent source-SAM proposal oracle and report primitive, peak-connected, proposal, fallback, oracle IoU, purity, coverage, and sibling leakage.
gaps: A label-free query-independent coverage audit is now complete, but only for eight views and a single-scale grid12 proposal set.
Only 7/21 field-only identity seeds have one-view proposal coverage and 1/21 have two-view coverage, so a benchmark prediction would be dominated by proposal undercoverage.
Oracle IoU, purity, sibling leakage, full legal source-view coverage, and a multiscale proposal hierarchy remain incomplete.

promotion.reason: The sparse coverage precursor is complete and explains the current undercoverage, but the specified full multiscale proposal/oracle experiment is not complete.

latest_attachment_object_topology_priori.recommendation: Train a low-dimensional source-only co-membership head with same-mask positives, co-visible disjoint negatives, unknown ignored, boundary hard negatives, multiscale masks, and geometry regularization.
gaps: Source validation improved instance-macro IoU from 0.13326 to 0.16034 but contamination also increased from 0.25299 to 0.27193.
The formal target one-shot was rejected by a 0.13559 mIoU regression versus O0.
The full recommended negative/unknown/multiscale Stage-A mask contract is not bound.

promotion.reason: The source head is a promising precursor, but the benchmark mechanism failed.

latest_attachment_object_topology_priori.recommendation: Create a SAM-mask-aligned language teacher using masked and context-expanded crops to supervise region summary, response, sibling distinction, and part-whole hierarchy.
gaps: A source-only sparse sentinel materialized five masked and five context official SigLIP2 descriptors with three geometric containment candidates, but it is not backed by a full multiscale hierarchy.
The sentinel contains no sibling candidate, and no cross-view association, sibling/part-whole training, source gate, or benchmark evaluation is complete.

promotion.reason: The mask-aligned descriptor precursor exists, but the defining multiscale supervision and trained/gated method are absent.

latest_attachment_object_topology_priori.recommendation: Apply a bounded region-consistent categorical residual inside high-confidence SAM-derived ScanNet regions while retaining typed calibration and deterministic ties.
gaps: Current paper8 official source-SAM masks are absent; the evaluated topology is a RADIO-to-SAM/local-feature weak proxy.
Safe one-hop continuous topology improves full8 mIoU by only about 0.00013-0.00019; multi-hop propagation collapses.
The larger development residual is scene0000-selected and is not the requested SAM-derived region hierarchy.

promotion.reason: A weak categorical consistency diagnostic exists, but not the specified source-SAM regional residual.

latest_attachment_object_topology_priori.recommendation: Add two-round points, box, coarse-mask, multiview lift-back SAM consensus for NVOS and SPIn, selected only by source/reference consistency.
gaps: The frozen NVOS fern sentinel rejected round two; the round-two aggregate regressed the sealed one-shot parent by 0.01327 foreground IoU.
The preregistered stop rule correctly prevented a full8 rollout.
A matching SPIn two-round multiview-consensus implementation and full-nine gate are absent.

promotion.reason: Implementation is partial and the only completed sentinel failed.

latest_attachment_general_priorities_P0_.recommendation: Freeze Universal Field capacity and losses until a same-readout exact-versus-D512 gap demonstrates a representation bottleneck.
gaps: The final same-readout exact/compact table is still missing, so the freeze remains a sound experimental policy rather than a completed capacity conclusion.

promotion.scope: method-development policy and field/readout separation only

latest_attachment_general_priorities_P0_.recommendation: Unify reliability semantics and persistence, exact-marginal metadata, cold storage, and bitwise RADIO decode across all five benchmarks.
gaps: The 12 LERF and ScanNet D512/L512 migrations pass coefficient, in-memory RADIO, and serialized RADIO bitwise probes.
Equivalent Universal Field v1 inventory and cold-state receipts are not yet jointly verified for NVOS and SPIn.
The requested actual cold-storage and warm-memory five-benchmark table is incomplete.

promotion.reason: Complete for the 12 LERF/ScanNet fields, not for the five-benchmark method identity.

latest_attachment_general_priorities_P0_.recommendation: Complete TextPosteriorV2 with primitive likelihood, anchor co-membership, region hierarchy, reliability-conditioned extent, calibrated posterior, and conservative projection while the field stays frozen.
gaps: The typed interface and zero-initialization compatibility exist, but the independent source-trained candidate failed its source LOSO gate.
The current bounded extent residual is not the complete TextPosteriorV2 and is query conditioned.
Corrected LERF3D improves pooled mIoU, Acc@0.25, and Acc@0.50, but transfer is unstable, two scenes regress, and the three-level contract remains incomplete.

promotion.reason: Interface completeness is not posterior-method completeness.

latest_attachment_general_priorities_P0_.recommendation: After recovering coarse object extent, restore a source-trained LERF2D boundary residual and report coarse/refined, Boundary-F, trimap IoU, and LocAcc.
gaps: The full4 development proxy improves sample-micro mIoU from 0.34975 to 0.36152 and is positive in each scene.
The prerequisite complete TextPosteriorV2 extent has not been recovered.
The current result is development-selected and does not close the requested prospective boundary/trimap/LocAcc promotion table.

promotion.reason: Positive weak-proxy evidence, but the prescribed sequence and full gate are incomplete.

latest_attachment_general_priorities_P0_.recommendation: Complete CategoricalPosteriorV2 with zero-init typed residual, source-trained shrinkage, temperature/bias, deterministic ties, and protocol-appropriate rejection.
gaps: The typed interface and a development head exist.
Both independent source-transfer candidates failed frozen LOSO: the full head regressed macro mIoU by 0.17308 and the two-scalar head by 0.05959.
Primitive Readout-v0 therefore remains the eligible ScanNet control.

promotion.reason: The transferable typed categorical readout has not passed source gates.

latest_attachment_general_priorities_P0_.recommendation: Freeze TransientRGBSAMAdapterV2 with points, box, optional mask-logit, signed evidence, two-pass multiview consensus, and no target-metric selection for NVOS and SPIn.
gaps: The one-shot NVOS signed-evidence SAM development result is available, but the upgraded two-round sentinel failed and was stopped.
The same frozen adapter and consensus contract is not complete for SPIn full-nine.
No unified five-benchmark adapter promotion exists.

promotion.reason: The upgraded adapter is not frozen because its first formal sentinel failed.

latest_attachment_general_priorities_P0_.recommendation: Run exact capability/MPR, D512/L512, and D256/L128 under the same TextPosteriorV2, CategoricalPosteriorV2, and PromptAdapterV2 readouts.
gaps: Existing NVOS/SPIn ladders and source-capacity gates cover only subsets of the requested comparison.
D512 is the first source-only capacity passing the current fidelity gates, but there is no same-final-readout exact/D512/D256 table on LERF and ScanNet.
TextPosteriorV2 and CategoricalPosteriorV2 are not frozen, so the requested attribution of error to representation versus readout cannot yet be made.

promotion.reason: The decisive controlled ladder is incomplete.

previous_attachment_priorities_P0_to_P6.recommendation: Name the persistent representation Universal Field v1 and keep Primitive Readout-v0 as a separate permanent baseline.

promotion.scope: method terminology, interface boundary, and baseline identity

previous_attachment_priorities_P0_to_P6.recommendation: Repair exact-marginal authority, reliability persistence, checkpoint schema, field signature, scalar semantics, and cold-storage audit before new formal assets.
gaps: Completed and bitwise-audited for 12 LERF/ScanNet fields.
Not yet sealed as one five-benchmark Universal Field v1 inventory including NVOS and SPIn.

promotion.reason: Subset-complete, not method-wide complete.

previous_attachment_priorities_P0_to_P6.recommendation: Train and validate TextPosteriorV2 on existing frozen fields with source-only supervision and strict LERF/ScanNet gates.
gaps: Interface tests pass, but the independent source-trained TextPosterior candidate failed its source gate.
No accepted full4 LERF plus ScanNet shared-field typed-posterior row exists.

promotion.reason: No gated transferable posterior.

previous_attachment_priorities_P0_to_P6.recommendation: Restore a source-trained LERF2D boundary head only after TextPosteriorV2 restores object extent.
gaps: A bounded development boundary proxy improves full4 mIoU by 0.01176.
The prerequisite TextPosteriorV2 extent and prospective promotion gate remain incomplete.

promotion.reason: Ordering and final gate are not satisfied.

previous_attachment_priorities_P0_to_P6.recommendation: Run the exact/D512/D256 representation ladder under the same new readout on LERF and ScanNet.
gaps: Partial ladders exist, but the requested same-readout LERF and ScanNet experiment does not.

promotion.reason: The representation-versus-readout attribution remains unresolved.

previous_attachment_priorities_P0_to_P6.recommendation: Continue reusable NVOS work but stage SPIn through representative sentinels before unconditional full-nine materialization.
gaps: NVOS reusable fields and one-shot transient results are complete.
The operational staging recommendation was later superseded by the explicit user request to run all available SPIn scenes, and it is not itself a benchmark-method promotion.

promotion.reason: Operationally partial and superseded; not a scientific result.

previous_attachment_priorities_P0_to_P6.recommendation: Run a final unified five-benchmark row only after field schema, typed readouts, transient adapter, method identity, no-per-scene parameters, and cold rebuild receipts are frozen.
gaps: TextPosteriorV2 and CategoricalPosteriorV2 are not promoted.
Transient Adapter V2 is not frozen across NVOS and SPIn.
SPIn full-nine Method-v1 result and one cold-start same-identity five-benchmark receipt are absent.

promotion.reason: The entry conditions for the final joint row are not satisfied.

next_decision.highest_information_gain_experiment: Implement latest-attachment object P0 exactly: automatic query-independent multi-scale source-SAM hierarchy, probability-correct exact-MPR lift, query-independent 3D proposals, and the complete oracle/purity/coverage/leakage table on frozen LERF fields before training another affinity or changing the Universal Field.
next_decision.reason: It consumes existing frozen LERF fields and source RGB, does not depend on SPIn field completion, and directly tests whether the expected large gain from explicit object membership is achievable.
